name: mirage
text: Got it. I'll fold the 'after your history' stars into one rating and fit it to your bets plus the API history: bet kind, side, sport, lead time, books agreeing, a sharp book agreeing, EV size, and whether both sides are offered. Winning types move up and losing types move down in proportion, on the same 1-5 scale. First I'll map how stars work now and measure each factor against CLV and results. I'll report what I find before I ship.
